steps.description: Filter out genes with low mean log2 expression across the 12 samples (floor set independent of group labels, e.g. below the empirical low-expression mode), requiring expression above the floor in at least 6 samples (the smaller group size). plan.title: Muscle treated vs control DE (limma-trend) + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) normalized values for 12 human muscle samples (6 treated, 6 control), no counts. This rules out count-based DESeq2/edgeR models (R-0019). The grounded procedure is: (1) QC sample structure on the log-scale matrix via PCA/MDS and sample-distance heatmap to confirm no outliers or unexpected batch structure before modeling; (2) filter low-abundance genes on mean log2 expression, independent of group labels; (3) confirm the matrix is already normalized (log2 TPM+1, range check) and skip re-normalization; (4) build a design matrix with an explicit reference level (control) and fit limma with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE eBayes, appropriate for log-scale abundance data (R-0019, R-0093); (5) extract results via topTable with BH adjustment, selecting genes by adjusted p-value (R-0043/R-0044); (6) run fgsea preranked GSEA on the moderated t-statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (follow-up), both staged locally for human, respecting the 15-500 gene set size window and reporting leading-edge genes; (7) produce a reproducibility-complete report with design, thresholds, DE gene counts, and enrichment caveats. No batch correction is needed (single batch, unpaired 6v6 design).
